defect: none; the request and acknowledgement each cross as persistent toggles
rationale: The source holds its request state until the destination acknowledgement toggle returns through two source-clock stages. The destination exposes a request only for an unconsumed toggle and acknowledges it in the destination domain.

mutation.description: Reduced the NRZ prim_sync_reqack handshake to its two persistent toggle crossings and held transaction state.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced to one source request and one destination acknowledgement without assertion machinery.
